description: The Stop hook runs the deterministic quality gate via stop-gate.mjs and, in warn-mode, writes the gate findings to .studio/gate/last-gate.json without blocking.

cases.given: Stop fires with stop_hook_active false after a session with a well-formed chapter
cases.expect: stop-gate.mjs runs ns-gate in warn mode, writes .studio/gate/last-gate.json, and exits 0

cases.given: Stop fires with stop_hook_active true (re-entrant stop turn)
cases.expect: stop-gate.mjs exits 0 without re-running the gate to avoid duplicate gate records
